import json
def solve(di):
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    # frame color: color of corners
    fc=di[0][0]
    # find frame bar rows/cols: rows/cols where fc count == W or H? use: full rows of fc within leading run? 
    # detect compartment structure: bar rows = rows that are entirely fc in some prefix? 
    # robust: candidate bar rows = rows where di[r][:k]==fc for many cols; take rows fully fc up to frame width.
    # determine frame width: max c such that col c is all fc? find columns where every row value in {0,fc} and first nonzero is fc... 
    fw=None
    for c in range(W):
        col=[di[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        if col.count(fc)==H:
            fw=c+1
    fh=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(di[r][c]==fc for c in range(fw)):
            fh=r+1
    bars=[r for r in range(H) if all(di[r][c]==fc for c in range(fw))]
    # chambers from consecutive bars
    import itertools
    groups=[]
    prev=None
    for b in bars+[H]:
        if prev is None:
            groups.append((prev,b))
        elif b>prev+1:
            groups.append((prev+1,b)); prev=b
        else:
            prev=b
    out=[[fc]*fw for _ in range(H)]
    # noise comps
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=di[r][c]
            if v!=0 and v!=fc and not seen[r][c]:
                comp=[];st=[(r,c)];seen[r][c]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop();comp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and di[x][y]!=0 and di[x][y]!=fc:
                            seen[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                comps.append(comp)
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0=min(rs); ch=(min(b for b in bars if b>r0)+1)-max(r for r in bars if r<r0) if False else None
        # chamber containing r0: find bar below r0
        bl=[b for b in bars if b>r0]
        br=max(bl) if bl else H
        top=max([b for b in bars if b<r0]+[0])
        chamber_h=br-top
        ch_cells=[(r,ch) for r in range(top+1,br) for ch in range(1,fw)]
        rh=r0-top; cw=min(cs)-1
        rel=[(r-r0,c-cw) for r,c in comp]
        oh=max(p[0] for p in rel)+1; ow=max(p[1] for p in rel)+1
        # vertical placement: top-aligned within chamber
        top_=top+1+(chamber_h-oh)//2
        for dr,dc in rel:
            rr,cc=top_+dr, cw+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<fw: out[rr][cc]=di[r0+cw][cw+dc]
    return out
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])))
print('match:', solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])

def solve(di):

    best=None
    for ra in range(H):
        for rb in range(ra+1,H):
            for ca in range(W):
                if not all(di[r][ca]==fc for r in range(ra,rb+1)): continue
                for cb in range(ca+1,W):
                    if not all(di[r][cb]==fc for r in range(ra,rb+1)): continue
                    ok=all(di[r][c]!=fc for r in range(ra+1,rb) for c in range(ca+1,cb))
                    a=(rb-ra)*(cb-ca)
                    if best is None or a>best[0]: best=(a,ra,rb,ca,cb)
    _,ra,rb,ca,cb=best
    out=[[fc]*(cb-ca+1) for _ in range(rb-ra+1)]
    icw=cb-ca-1
    comps=[];seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=di[r][c]
            if v!=0 and v!=fc and not seen[r][c]:
                comp=[(r,c)];seen[r][c]=True;st=[(r,c)]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+da,y+db
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and di[nx][ny]!=0 and di[nx][ny]!=fc:
                            seen[nx][ny]=True;comp.append((nx,ny));st.append((nx,ny))
                comps.append(comp)
    # group by color: union same-color cells across comps
    cellsets={}
    for comp in comps:
        v=di[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]
        cellsets.setdefault(v,set()).update(comp)

    barrows=[r for r in range(ra,rb+1) if all(di[r][c]==fc for c in range(ca,cb+1))]
    bands=[(barrows[i]+1,barrows[i+1]-1) if i<len(barrows)-1 else (barrows[-1]+1,rb) for i in range(len(barrows))]
    slots=[]

import json
def solve(di):
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0]); fc=di[0][0]
    # frame: bounding box of all fc cells
    frs=[r for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==fc]
    fcs=[c for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if di[r][c]==fc]
    ra,rb,min_c,max_c=min(frs),max(frs),min(fcs),max(fcs)
    out=[[fc]*(max_c-min_c+1) for _ in range(rb-ra+1)]
    icw=max_c-min_c-1
    # noise comps
    comps=[];seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=di[r][c]
            if v!=0 and v!=fc and not seen[r][c]:
                comp=[(r,c)];seen[r][c]=True;st=[(r,c)]
                while st:
                    x,y=st.pop()
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+da,y+db
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and not seen[nx][ny] and di[nx][ny]!=0 and di[nx][ny]!=fc:
                            seen[nx][ny]=True;comp.append((nx,ny));st.append((nx,ny))
                comps.append(comp)
    # union same-color comps
    cellsets={}
    for comp in comps:
        v=di[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]
        cellsets.setdefault(v,set()).update(comp)
    shapes=[sorted(cs) for cs in cellsets.values()]
    n=len(shapes)
    for k,shp in enumerate(shapes):
        rs=[r for r,_ in shp]; mr=min(rs)
        # target band index = k (same order top->bottom) ... verify on demo first
        t_=ra+k*(rb-ra)//(n-1) if n>1 else ra
        mc=min(c for _,c in shp)
        ow=max(c for _,c in shp)-mc+1
        coff=(icw-ow)//2
        for r,c in shp:
            rr=t_+(r-mr); cc=min_c+1+coff+(c-mc)
            out[rr][cc]=di[r][c]
    return out

import json
def framebands(di):
    fc=di[0][0]; H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    ra,rb,ca,cb=0,H-1,0,W-1  # assume full grid is frame+noise region? use barrows detection on whole grid
    ba=[r for r in range(H) if all(di[r][c]==fc for c in range(W))]
    bnds=[(ba[i]+1,ba[i+1]-1) for i in range(len(ba)-1)]
    return fc,bnds
d1=G['Demo pair 1 input']; o1=G['Demo pair 1 output']
d2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; o2=G['Demo pair 2 output']
for name,d,O in [('demo1',d1,o1),('demo2',d2,o2)]:
    fc,bnds=framebands(d)
    print(name,'fc',fc,'bnds',bnds)
    # get colors per band in input & output
    icol={}
    for t_,b_ in bnds:
        cols=set(O[r][c] for r in range(t_,b_+1) for c in range(len(O[0])) if O[r][c]!=fc)
        icol.setdefault((t_,b_),set()).update(cols)
    print('  out colors per band:',{k:sorted(v) for k,v in icol.items()})
# shapes scan-order per band:
def shporder(d,bnds):
    res=[]
    for t_,b_ in bnds:
        cols=[O_ := d[r][c] for r in range(t_,b_+1) for c in range(len(d[0])) if d[r][c]!=d[0][0]]
        res.append(sorted(set(cols)))
    return res
print('in band colors:',shporder(d1,bnds))
print('out band colors:',shporder(o1,bnds))

import json, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Build a general solver: detect frame rects via maximal fc-bordered rects enclosing non-fc content; shapes go to band interiors.
def solve(inp,O=None,verbose=True):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); fc=inp[0][0]
    # strip rows: rows that are constant non-zero
    srows=[(r,inp[r][0]) for r in range(H) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=0]
    # group consecutive identical-color stripe rows into separators; band = rows strictly between two consecutive stripe rows
    bands=[]; prev=None
    for r,f in srows:
        if prev is not None and r>prev+1: bands.append((prev+1,r-1))
        prev=r
    shapes=ncomp(inp,{fc})
    res=[]
    for s in shapes:
        if len(s)>10: continue  # ignore the huge frame ring itself
        col=inp[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        pats=[None]*len(bands)
        ok=False
        for ti,(t_,b_) in enumerate(bands):
            oset={(rr,c) for rr in range(t_,b_+1) for c in range(W) if O[rr][c]==col} if O else set()
            # check dihedral match any translate
            tvs=diheds(norm(s))
            m_=any({(a+x,b+y) for a,b in tv}==oset for tv in tvs for a in range(-6,7) for b in range(-6,7))
            if m_: pats[ti]=norm(s); ok=True
        if verbose: print('color',col,'shape',sorted(norm(s)),'bands hit:',[i for i,v in enumerate(pats) if v])
    return bands
for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print('===',key)
    solve(G[key+' input'],G[key+' output'],True)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # frame rect: largest rect whose border is one constant nonzero color
    best=None
    for r0 in range(H):
        for r1 in range(r0,H):
            for c0 in range(W):
                for c1 in range(c0,W):
                    col=inp[r0][c0]
                    if col==0: continue
                    ok=all(inp[r][c]==col for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in (c0,c1)) \
                       and all(inp[r][c]==col for r in (r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
                    area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
                    if ok and (best is None or area>best[0]):
                        best=(area,r0,r1,c0,c1,col)
    _,r0,r1,c0,c1,col=best
    # interior bands from full separator rows
    seps=[r for r in range(H) if all(inp[r][c]==col for c in range(W))]
    bands=[]; prev=None
    for s in seps:
        if prev is not None and s>prev+1: bands.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s
    bands.append((seps[-1]+1,H-1)) if seps else None
    comps=ncomp(inp,{col})
    # discard components touching the frame border ring -> keep only those strictly inside some band
    shapes=[]
    for s in comps:
        rs=[r for r,_ in s]; cs=[c for _,c in s]
        if max(rs)>r1 or min(rs)<r0 or max(cs)>c1 or min(cs)<c0: continue
        shapes.append(s)
    assert len(shapes)==len(bands), (len(shapes),len(bands))
    out=[[col]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(H)]
    for si,s in enumerate(shapes):
        col=inp[s[0][0]][s[0][1]]
        newb=bands[(si-1+len(bands))%len(bands)]
        nr=min(r for r,_ in s)-r0+newb[0]
        nc=min(c for _,c in s)-c0+1
        for (r,c) in s:
            out[nr+r-min(r for r,_ in s)][nc+c-min(c for _,c in s)]=col
    return out

for key in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    p=G[key+' input']; O=G[key+' output']
    r=solve(p)
    print(key,'match:',r==O, 'pred',len(r),'x',len(r[0]),'expected',len(O),'x',len(O[0]))
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(inp):
    a,r0,r1,c0,c1,fc=frame_rect(inp)
    print('frame',r0,r1,c0,c1,'fc',fc,'area',a)
    seps=set(r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if all(inp[r][c]==fc for c in range(c0,c1+1)))
    slots=[]; cur=None
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if r in seps:
            if cur is not None: slots.append(cur); cur=None
        else:
            if cur is None: cur=[r]
            else: cur.append(r)
    if cur: slots.append(cur)
    print('seps',sorted(seps),'slots',[(x[0],x[-1]) for x in slots])
    # shapes right of frame (outside), plus inside? collect components
    comps=comps_of(inp,{fc})
    outside=[s for s in comps if all(not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) for r,c in s)]
    inside=[s for s in comps if all(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) for _ in [0]]
    inside_ok=[s for s in inside if all( not (r==seps_v and min(r0,r1)<=c<=max(r0,r1)) for r,c in s) ]
    print('outside comps:',[(min(r for r,_ in s),max(r for r,_ in s),min(c for _,c in s),max(c for _,c in s),inp[s[0][0]][s[0][1]],len(s)) for s in outside])
    print('inside comps:',[(min(r for r,_ in s),max(r for r,_ in s),min(c for _,c in s),max(c for _,c in s),inp[s[0][0]][s[0][1]],len(s)) for s in inside_ok])
    return fc,seps,slots,outside,inside_ok

def comps(g, exclude=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if seen[r][c] or g[r][c]==0 or (exclude and g[r][c] in exclude): continue
            st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]!=0 and (not exclude or g[x][y] not in exclude):
                        seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
            out.append(cells)
    return out

G=load()
from collections import Counter
def comps(g, exclude=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if seen[r][c] or g[r][c]==0 or (exclude and g[r][c] in exclude): continue
            st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
            while st:
                a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]!=0 and (not exclude or g[x][y] not in exclude):
                        seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
            out.append(cells)
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi=G[k+' input']
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row if x)
    fc=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    fr=comps(gi,{fc})[0]
    rs=[r for r,_ in fr]; cs=[c for _,c in fr]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # separate outside components: those not inside frame bbox
    inside=set((r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1))

    for cc in ext:

        rs=[r for r,_ in cc]; cs=[c for _,c in cc]

        print('  color',col,'size',len(cc),'bbox',(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)),'rel',rel)

import json
from collections import Counter, deque

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x)
    fc=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    # frame bbox: rows/cols that are fully fc
    full_rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]==fc for c in range(W))]
    full_cols=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==fc for r in range(H))]
    r0=min(full_rows); r1=max(full_rows); c0=min(full_cols); c1=max(full_cols)
    # interior rows between consecutive separator rows within frame
    seps=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if all(g[r][c]==fc for c in range(c0,c1+1))]
    bands=[];cur=None
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if r in seps:
            if cur is not None: bands.append(cur); cur=None
        else:
            cur=[r] if cur is None else cur+[r]
    if cur is not None: bands.append(cur)
    # outside components, 8-connectivity
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if seen[r][c] or g[r][c]==0 or g[r][c]==fc or (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1): continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]);seen[r][c]=True;cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft();cells.append((a,b))
                for da in (-1,0,1):
                    for db in (-1,0,1):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]!=0 and g[x][y]!=fc:
                            seen[x][y]=True;q.append((x,y))
            comps.append(cells)
    nb=len(bands)
    if len(comps)>nb:
        comps.sort(key=lambda cc:(-len(cc),g[cc[0][0]][cc[0][1]]))
        comps=comps[:nb]
    out=[[fc]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
    for j,cc in enumerate(comps):
        mr=min(r for r,_ in cc); mc=min(c for _,c in cc)
        rel=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in cc]
        bh=max(r for r,_ in rel)-min(r for r,_ in rel)+1
        if bh>len(bands[j]): continue  # noise that doesn't fit
        br=bands[j][0]
        # horizontal offset: 0 (centered/left) ; exceptions handled per-demo analysis
        oc=c0+0
        for (r_,c_) in rel:
            rr=br+r_-min(r for r,_ in rel)
            if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=oc+c_<len(out[0]):
                out[rr][oc+c_]=g[cc[0][0]][cc[0][1]]
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    o=solve(G[k+' input'])
    exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match' if o==exp else 'MISMATCH')
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def f(g):

    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=0)
    fc=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    big=max(comps_of(g),key=lambda cc:len(cc))
    rs=[r for r,_ in big];cs=[c for _,c in big]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    seps={r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if all(g[r][c]==fc for c in range(c0,c1+1))}
    bands=[];cur=None
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if r in seps:
            if cur is not None: bands.append(cur); cur=None
        else:
            cur=(r,) if cur is None else cur+(r,)
    if cur: bands.append(cur)
    outside=[cc for cc in comps_of(g) if cc is not big and any(r<r0 or r>r1 or (c<c0 or c>c1) for r,c in cc)]
    fh=c1-c0+1
    out=[[fc]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
    # copy frame region as-is
    for rr,row in enumerate(g[r0:r1+1]):
        for c2,x in enumerate(row[c0:c1+1]):
            if x!=fc: out[rr][c2]=x
    shapes=[]
    for cc in outside:

        shapes.append((len(cc),col,cc))

    for idx,(n,col,cc) in enumerate(shapes):

    best=None

        cc=comps(gi,c); cc.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
        big=cc[0]
        ys=[y for y,x in big]; xs=[x for y,x in big]
        y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
